modal.title: Backup and Restore Database
modal.subtitleSqlite: Consistent backup via VACUUM INTO and file management.
modal.subtitleMysql: Comprehensive tool for high-speed backups and smart restoration.

backupTab.hotBackupSubtitle: SQLite produces a consistent, optimized snapshot of the entire database.
backupTab.vacuumIntro2: directly generates a complete, optimized binary SQLite database file.
backupTab.vacuumBullet1: Does not block concurrent reads during the copy.
backupTab.vacuumBullet2: Automatically includes all tables ({{count}}), indexes, views, and schemas.
backupTab.vacuumBullet3: Defragments the resulting file for minimal disk size.
backupTab.singleSqlDesc: Standard dump into a single plain SQL text file.
backupTab.structuredDirDesc: Chunked partitioning, Zstandard compression, and per-chunk SHA-256 verification.

contentOptions.wholeDbDesc: Includes all tables ({{count}}), views, routines, and triggers.
contentOptions.specificTablesDesc: Manually choose individual tables to back up.
contentOptions.noTables: No tables available in this database.
contentOptions.structureAndDataDesc: Full DDL schema + optimized INSERT statements.
contentOptions.structureOnlyDesc: Tables, views, indexes, functions, and triggers without rows.
contentOptions.dataOnlyDesc: Multi-row INSERT statements only, without DDL definitions.
contentOptions.disableFk: Temporarily disable foreign key checks in the script
contentOptions.includeReplication: Include replication coordinates (requires a brief global lock in MySQL)

dirSettings.destDirPlaceholder: Absolute path to the target folder...
dirSettings.fullDesc: Dumps all tables and their data into new chunks.
dirSettings.diffDesc: Computes CHECKSUM TABLE and only exports modified tables.
dirSettings.incDesc: Captures binary log events for point-in-time recovery.
dirSettings.baseBackupHint: Origin to continue the binlog chain
dirSettings.chainValid: Replication chain is continuous and intact

backupResults.nonTransactionalDesc: Tables {{tables}} use engines without transactional support (MyISAM/Aria). Their data was exported but does not participate in the consistent snapshot.
backupResults.sqliteNote2: command generated a clean, identical, defragmented copy of the database without altering the active database or blocking reads.

restoreTab.sqliteSubtitle: SQLite stores each database in a single self-contained file on disk.
restoreTab.sqliteIntro: To restore a backup or work with a previous .sqlite3 / .db file:
restoreTab.option1Title: Option 1: Open as a new connection
restoreTab.option1Desc: You can connect to the backup file at any time using the SQLite connection dialog in PyroStudio without overwriting the current file.
restoreTab.option2Desc: If you want to completely replace your original database, disconnect the active session and replace the database file in your file explorer with the backup file.
restoreTab.sqlFileDesc: Standard DDL script and INSERT statements.
restoreTab.structuredDirDesc: Streaming block restore with Zstandard / Gzip and differential support.
restoreTab.existingDbDesc: Overwrites or inserts into an existing database.
restoreTab.newDbDesc: Creates a new UTF-8 mb4 schema before restoring.
restoreTab.newDbNameLabel: Name of the new Database to create:

restoreSource.snapshotDesc: Restores a full or differential structured dump.
restoreSource.pitDesc: Applies base backup + chronological chain of binlogs.
restoreSource.baseDirMovedHint: Only if the base backup moved to another location
restoreSource.noIncrementals: No incremental folders added. Add one or more incremental backup folders.

verifyTab.invalidTitle: Backup has inconsistencies or corrupted files
verifyTab.missingListTitle: Files declared in manifest not found on disk:
verifyTab.dirPlaceholder: Absolute path to folder containing manifest.json...
verifyTab.description: PyroStudio will read manifest.json, recompute the cryptographic SHA-256 hashes of each partitioned chunk, and verify Zstandard or Gzip decompression integrity without loading data into the engine.

profilesTab.editorSubtitle: Configure automatic scheduler frequency, dump format, and smart retention rules.
profilesTab.chainProtection: Chain protection: If a base backup has active associated differential copies, the retention engine will never purge it, preserving full restore capability.
profilesTab.listSubtitle: The background scheduler periodically evaluates and runs active profiles.
profilesTab.emptyDesc: Create profiles with automatic schedules (hourly, daily, weekly) and smart retention policies to protect your databases.
profilesTab.retentionTitleAttr: Enforce retention and protect base backups

historyTab.title: Execution History ({{count}})
historyTab.subtitle: Audit log of all manually or automatically executed backups.
historyTab.emptyDesc: Scheduled automatic and manual runs will appear here with full metrics for time, rows, and bytes transferred.
